ex.en: Sign up for our newsletter to get the latest deals.
ex.zh: 訂閱我們的電子報以獲得最新優惠。

ex.en: The company newsletter comes out every month.
ex.zh: 公司的內部通訊每個月出刊一次。

newsletter.en: a short report with news that is sent regularly to members or customers

ex.en: I bought a magazine at the newsstand.
ex.zh: 我在書報攤買了一本雜誌。

ex.en: There's a newsstand outside the station.
ex.zh: 車站外面有一個書報攤。

newsstand.en: a small stand on the street where newspapers and magazines are sold

ex.en: A computer is an absolute necessity now.
ex.zh: 電腦現在是絕對的必需品。

ex.en: In the United States the automobile is a necessity and not a luxury.
ex.zh: 在美國，汽車是必需品而不是奢侈品。

ex.en: Clean water is a basic necessity.
ex.zh: 乾淨的水是基本必需品。

ex.en: Labor is not merely a necessity but a pleasure.
ex.zh: 勞動不只是必要的，也是一種樂趣。

ex.en: There's no necessity to book in advance.
ex.zh: 沒有必要事先預訂。

necessity.en: the fact that something has to be done or has to exist

ex.en: She has very neat handwriting.
ex.zh: 她的字寫得很工整。

ex.en: There was a neat pile of books in the corner of the room.
ex.zh: 房間角落整整齊齊地放著一疊書。

ex.en: Tom isn't as neat as he used to be.
ex.zh: 湯姆沒有以前那麼愛整潔了。

ex.en: That was pretty neat.
ex.zh: 那真的很酷。

ex.en: That's a neat idea!
ex.zh: 這個點子真不錯！

ex.en: The new app has some neat features.
ex.zh: 這個新 App 有一些很棒的功能。

ex.en: Tom found Mary's necklace under the sofa.
ex.zh: 湯姆在沙發底下找到了瑪麗的項鍊。

ex.en: My grandma gave me this necklace.
ex.zh: 這條項鍊是我奶奶送我的。

ex.en: I still cherish the necklace you gave me ten years ago.
ex.zh: 我到現在還很珍惜你十年前送我的項鍊。

necklace.en: jewelry that you wear around your neck

ex.en: The charity provides food for needy families.
ex.zh: 這個慈善機構為貧困家庭提供食物。

ex.en: The money will go to needy students.
ex.zh: 這筆錢會用來幫助需要的學生。

needy.en: very poor and lacking things such as food and money

needy.zh: （感情上）黏人的、很需要關注的

ex.en: He's a bit too needy in relationships.
ex.zh: 他在感情裡有點太黏人了。

ex.en: My cat gets very needy in the morning.
ex.zh: 我的貓早上特別黏人。

needy.en: always wanting attention and love from other people

ex.en: Switzerland is a neutral country.
ex.zh: 瑞士是中立國。

ex.en: As a manager, you should stay neutral.
ex.zh: 身為主管，你應該保持中立。

neutral.en: not supporting either side in an argument or war

ex.en: The office is painted in neutral colors.
ex.zh: 辦公室漆成中性色調。

ex.en: Try to use neutral language in the email.
ex.zh: 郵件裡盡量用中性的措辭。

neutral.en: not strong or bright, such as gray or beige

ex.en: The accident was caused by negligence.
ex.zh: 這起事故是疏忽造成的。

ex.en: The company was sued for negligence.
ex.zh: 這家公司因過失被告。

ex.en: Medical negligence is a serious issue.
ex.zh: 醫療疏失是很嚴重的問題。

negligence.en: failure to take enough care, which can cause harm

ex.en: Tom is a newcomer.
ex.zh: 湯姆是新來的。

ex.en: He's a newcomer.
ex.zh: 他是新來的。

ex.en: The company is a newcomer to the market.
ex.zh: 這家公司是市場上的新進者。

newcomer.en: a person who has only just arrived or started

ex.en: The prefix "neo" means "new," as in neoclassical.
ex.zh: 字首「neo」的意思是「新」，例如 neoclassical（新古典的）。

ex.en: Words that start with "neo" often describe a modern version of something old.
ex.zh: 以「neo」開頭的字常用來形容某種舊事物的新版本。

neo.en: a word part meaning new or in a new form

ex.en: She is a tough negotiator.
ex.zh: 她是一位強硬的談判者。

ex.en: Negotiators from both companies met in Tokyo.
ex.zh: 兩家公司的談判代表在東京會面。

negotiator.en: a person whose job is to talk with others to reach an agreement

ex.en: It's time for you to buy a new car.
ex.zh: 你該買一台新車了。

ex.en: Tom's car is newer than Mary's car.
ex.zh: 湯姆的車比瑪麗的新。

ex.en: You will soon get accustomed to your new school.
ex.zh: 你很快就會適應新學校。

ex.en: I'm new here. Where is the meeting room?
ex.zh: 我是新來的，會議室在哪裡？

ex.en: Tom came to see if Mary needed any help.
ex.zh: 湯姆過來看看瑪麗需不需要幫忙。

ex.en: The floor in this area needs to be redone.
ex.zh: 這一區的地板需要重新施工。

need.en: to require something because it is important or necessary

ex.en: You don't need to go unless you want to.
ex.zh: 如果你不想去，就不必去。

ex.en: Tom knew he no longer needed to help Mary.
ex.zh: 湯姆知道自己不需要再幫瑪莉了。

need.en: to have to do something because it is important

ex.en: There is no need to worry.
ex.zh: 不需要擔心。

ex.en: We must meet the needs of our customers.
ex.zh: 我們必須滿足顧客的需求。

need.en: a situation in which something is necessary or wanted

ex.en: My father will possibly come on the next train.
ex.zh: 我父親可能會搭下一班火車來。

ex.en: What will we be doing this time next week?
ex.zh: 下週的這個時候我們會在做什麼？

next.en: coming straight after this one in time or order

ex.en: What should we do next?
ex.zh: 我們接下來該做什麼？

ex.en: Next, add the eggs.
ex.zh: 接著加入蛋。

next.en: after this, or at the following time

ex.en: Finishing the report by tomorrow is next to impossible.
ex.zh: 要在明天之前完成報告幾乎不可能。

ex.en: The bank is next to the post office.
ex.zh: 銀行在郵局旁邊。

ex.en: You'll never achieve anything if you don't study harder.
ex.zh: 如果你不更用功，就永遠不會有成就。

ex.en: I will never tell a lie from now on.
ex.zh: 從現在起，我再也不說謊了。

ex.en: In 1900, he left England, and he never returned.
ex.zh: 他在1900年離開英國，從此沒再回去。

never.en: at no time, or not ever

ex.en: Never mind, I'll do it myself.
ex.zh: 沒關係，我自己來。

ex.en: Never mind the cost.
ex.zh: 別管費用了。

never.en: used to tell someone that something is not important

ex.en: I ran across an old friend near the bank.
ex.zh: 我在銀行附近巧遇一位老朋友。

ex.en: Is there a pharmacy near here?
ex.zh: 這附近有藥局嗎？

near.en: at a short distance from something

ex.en: The ambulances carried the injured to the nearest hospital.
ex.zh: 救護車把傷患送到最近的醫院。

ex.en: Can you tell me where the nearest bus stop is?
ex.zh: 你能告訴我最近的公車站在哪裡嗎？

ex.en: These problems will be solved in the near future.
ex.zh: 這些問題在不久的將來都會解決。

ex.en: We plan to open a new store in the near future.
ex.zh: 我們計畫在不久的將來開一家新店。

ex.en: My patience is nearing its limit.
ex.zh: 我的耐心快到極限了。

ex.en: The project is nearing completion.
ex.zh: 這個專案即將完成。

near.en: to come close to something in distance, time, or level

ex.en: It isn't necessary for us to attend this lecture.
ex.zh: 我們沒必要出席這場講座。

ex.en: A passport is usually necessary when you travel overseas.
ex.zh: 出國旅行通常需要護照。

ex.en: It is necessary for you to go there immediately.
ex.zh: 你必須馬上去那裡。

necessary.en: needed in order to get a result

ex.en: I was kept waiting for nearly half an hour.
ex.zh: 我等了將近半小時。

ex.en: I've dreamt about you nearly every night this week.
ex.zh: 這個禮拜我幾乎每晚都夢到你。

ex.en: Texas is nearly twice as large as Japan.
ex.zh: 德州差不多是日本的兩倍大。

ex.en: You nearly poked me in the eye with your pencil.
ex.zh: 你的鉛筆差點戳到我的眼睛。

ex.en: I nearly missed the train this morning.
ex.zh: 我今天早上差點錯過火車。

nearly.en: used to say that something almost happened but did not

ex.en: Hackers find new ways of infiltrating private or public networks.
ex.zh: 駭客找到滲透私人或公共網路的新方法。

ex.en: Please connect to the office network.
ex.zh: 請連上辦公室網路。

network.en: a group of computers that are connected so they can share information

ex.en: The UK must improve the problems with its rail network.
ex.zh: 英國必須改善鐵路網的問題。

ex.en: You shouldn't share too much private information on the social networks.
ex.zh: 你不應該在社群網路上分享太多私人資訊。

network.en: a system of lines or routes that connect many places

ex.en: Building a professional network is important for your career.
ex.zh: 建立職場人脈對你的職涯很重要。

ex.en: She has a large network of contacts.
ex.zh: 她人脈很廣。

network.en: a group of people you know and can share help and information with

ex.en: The school-enterprise networking event was held as scheduled on December 26th.
ex.zh: 校企交流會於 12 月 26 日如期舉行。

ex.en: Conferences are a great place to network.
ex.zh: 研討會是拓展人脈的好地方。

network.en: to meet and talk with people to make useful contacts

ex.en: My father will often read the newspaper during meals.
ex.zh: 我父親常在吃飯時看報紙。

ex.en: You can buy all kinds of newspapers at the bookstore.
ex.zh: 你可以在書店買到各種報紙。

ex.en: Starting next month, I'm not subscribing to a newspaper.
ex.zh: 從下個月開始，我不再訂報紙了。

newspaper.en: large printed sheets with reports of recent events, sold every day

ex.en: Let go of your negative outlook on life.
ex.zh: 放下你那負面的人生觀吧。

ex.en: Having a competitive mentality can give rise to negative emotions.
ex.zh: 愛比較的心態會讓人產生負面情緒。

ex.en: Smiling is the best remedy for negative emotions.
ex.zh: 微笑是對付負面情緒的最佳良藥。

ex.en: My teacher taught me that you can take the square root of a negative number.
ex.zh: 我的老師教我負數也可以開平方根。

ex.en: The test result was negative.
ex.zh: 檢驗結果是陰性。

negative.en: showing no sign of a condition, or less than zero

ex.en: The fisherman caught a purple jellyfish in his net.
ex.zh: 漁夫用網子捕到一隻紫色水母。

ex.en: He is using a fishing net to fish.
ex.zh: 他正在用漁網捕魚。

ex.en: He fixed the net.
ex.zh: 他把網子修好了。

net.en: material made of crossed threads with holes, used to catch things

ex.en: Our net profit rose by 15 percent this year.
ex.zh: 今年我們的淨利成長了百分之十五。

ex.en: What is your net income after tax?
ex.zh: 你的稅後淨收入是多少？

net.en: remaining after costs or other amounts have been taken away

ex.en: The company netted two million dollars last year.
ex.zh: 這家公司去年淨賺兩百萬元。

ex.en: The sale netted us a good profit.
ex.zh: 這筆買賣讓我們賺了不錯的利潤。

net.en: to earn a profit after costs have been taken away

ex.en: Maria knew neither his name nor his phone number.
ex.zh: 瑪莉亞既不知道他的名字，也不知道他的電話。

ex.en: It's good now; neither too heavy nor too light.
ex.zh: 現在剛好，不重也不輕。

ex.en: Neither Tom nor Mary has a very good memory.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗的記性都不太好。

neither.en: used to show that two things are both not true

ex.en: Neither of those two students passed the test.
ex.zh: 那兩個學生都沒通過考試。

ex.en: Neither of the options is perfect.
ex.zh: 兩個選項都不完美。

neither.en: not one and not the other of two people or things

ex.en: He cannot speak English, neither can he speak French.
ex.zh: 他不會說英文，也不會說法文。

ex.en: "I don't like coffee." "Neither do I."
ex.zh: 「我不喜歡咖啡。」「我也不喜歡。」

neither.en: used to say that a negative statement is also true for another person

necessarily.zh: 必然、一定（not necessarily 不一定）

ex.en: Large houses are not necessarily comfortable to live in.
ex.zh: 大房子住起來不一定舒服。

ex.en: What he says is not necessarily true.
ex.zh: 他說的不一定對。

ex.en: This work is not necessarily easy.
ex.zh: 這份工作不一定容易。

necessarily.en: in a way that cannot be avoided

ex.en: I am tired; nevertheless, I must finish my homework.
ex.zh: 我很累，但我還是得把作業寫完。

ex.en: It's just five in the morning, but nevertheless it is light out.
ex.zh: 才早上五點，但外面已經亮了。

ex.en: The plan was risky; nevertheless, we decided to try it.
ex.zh: 這個計畫有風險，儘管如此，我們還是決定試試看。

nevertheless.en: in spite of what has just been said

ex.en: Last week's storm damaged many trees in our neighborhood.
ex.zh: 上週的暴風雨損壞了我們社區的許多樹。

ex.en: There is a big supermarket in my neighborhood.
ex.zh: 我家附近有一間大超市。

ex.en: The whole neighborhood was surprised at the news.
ex.zh: 整個社區都對這個消息感到驚訝。

neighborhood.en: a part of a town where people live, or the people there

ex.en: The repairs will cost in the neighborhood of $500.
ex.zh: 維修費大約要 500 美元。

ex.en: Rent here is in the neighborhood of 20,000 dollars a month.
ex.zh: 這裡的房租大約每月兩萬元。

neighborhood.en: used to say that a number or amount is about the same as another

ex.en: The negotiation is off.
ex.zh: 談判破裂了。

ex.en: A free-trade agreement between Europe and the United States is currently under negotiation.
ex.zh: 歐洲和美國之間的自由貿易協定目前正在協商中。

ex.en: I can translate between Chinese and English, and can participate in negotiations with foreigners.
ex.zh: 我能做中英翻譯，也能參與和外國人的談判。

negotiation.en: a formal discussion to reach an agreement

ex.en: The girl had a long scarf around her neck.
ex.zh: 女孩脖子上圍著一條長圍巾。

ex.en: I got up today with a pain in my neck.
ex.zh: 我今天起床時脖子很痛。

ex.en: The cat had a ribbon around its neck.
ex.zh: 小貓脖子上繫著一條緞帶。

neck.en: the part of the body between the head and the shoulders

ex.en: I was very nervous as the plane took off.
ex.zh: 飛機起飛時我非常緊張。

ex.en: I always get nervous just before a match.
ex.zh: 我比賽前總是很緊張。

ex.en: I never make a speech without being nervous.
ex.zh: 我每次演講都會緊張。

nervous.en: worried or a little afraid about something

ex.en: The newly bought quilt is very warm when covered.
ex.zh: 新買的被子蓋起來很暖和。

ex.en: It only takes 20 minutes to get to school by the newly opened subway.
ex.zh: 搭新開通的捷運上學只要二十分鐘。

ex.en: The newly hired staff will start on Monday.
ex.zh: 新進員工將在星期一開始上班。

ex.en: You are not to neglect your duty.
ex.zh: 你不可以疏忽你的職責。

ex.en: He neglected his duties.
ex.zh: 他怠忽職守。

ex.en: Thanks to television, boys and girls are apt to neglect reading books.
ex.zh: 因為電視，孩子們往往忽略了讀書。

neglect.en: to fail to give enough care or attention to someone or something

ex.en: The old house fell into neglect.
ex.zh: 那棟老房子年久失修。

ex.en: The accident was caused by neglect.
ex.zh: 這場意外是疏忽造成的。

neglect.en: failure to give enough care or attention

ex.en: The injury damaged a nerve in his arm.
ex.zh: 這次受傷傷到了他手臂的神經。

ex.en: Nerves carry signals to the brain.
ex.zh: 神經把訊號傳到大腦。

nerve.en: a thin fiber that carries messages between the brain and the body

ex.en: She had the nerve to speak out.
ex.zh: 她竟然有膽說出來。

ex.en: Tom lost his nerve.
ex.zh: 湯姆膽怯了。

ex.en: I didn't have the nerve to ask for a raise.
ex.zh: 我沒有勇氣要求加薪。

nerve.en: courage, or a rude lack of shame

nerve.zh: get on one's nerves：使人心煩

ex.en: It's a complete mess, and it's getting on my nerves.
ex.zh: 這完全是一團亂，讓我很心煩。

ex.en: That music gets on his nerves.
ex.zh: 那音樂讓他很煩。

ex.en: My nerves were bad before the job interview.
ex.zh: 求職面試前我非常緊張。

ex.en: She drank some water to calm her nerves.
ex.zh: 她喝了點水平復緊張的情緒。

nerve.en: a feeling of worry or fear before something important

ex.en: Birds make their nests in trees.
ex.zh: 鳥在樹上築巢。

ex.en: Birds build nests of twigs.
ex.zh: 鳥用細樹枝築巢。

nest.en: a home that birds or small animals make for their eggs and young

ex.en: Children all leave the nest one day.
ex.zh: 孩子們總有一天都會離家獨立。

ex.en: My son finally left the nest last year.
ex.zh: 我兒子去年終於搬出去獨立了。

nest.en: a warm and safe home, especially for a family

ex.en: Birds nest in the trees behind our house.
ex.zh: 鳥在我們家後面的樹上築巢。

ex.en: Swallows often nest under the roof.
ex.zh: 燕子常在屋簷下築巢。

nest.en: to build or use a home for eggs and young

ex.en: The company is training a neural network to recognize faces.
ex.zh: 這家公司正在訓練一個神經網路來辨識人臉。

ex.en: Neural activity increases when we learn something new.
ex.zh: 我們學習新事物時，神經活動會增加。

neural.en: relating to the nerves or the brain

ex.en: The brain contains billions of neurons.
ex.zh: 大腦含有數十億個神經元。

ex.en: Neurons send signals throughout the body.
ex.zh: 神經元把訊號傳送到全身。

neuron.en: a cell that carries messages in the brain and nerves

ex.en: The newscaster reported the election results.
ex.zh: 新聞主播報導了選舉結果。

ex.en: She has worked as a newscaster for ten years.
ex.zh: 她當新聞主播已經十年了。

newscaster.en: a person who reads the news on television or radio

ex.en: The humble man is getting along with his neighbors.
ex.zh: 那個謙虛的人和鄰居相處得很好。

ex.en: A close neighbor is better than a distant relative.
ex.zh: 遠親不如近鄰。

ex.en: They set fire to their neighbor's house in revenge.
ex.zh: 為了報仇，他們放火燒了鄰居的家。

neighbor.en: a person who lives next to or near you

ex.en: Cultural exchange programs can strengthen friendly relations between neighboring countries.
ex.zh: 文化交流計劃可以加強鄰國之間的友好關係。

ex.en: This country considers every neighboring country as a threat.
ex.zh: 這個國家把所有鄰國都視為威脅。

neighbor.en: located close to or next to another place

ex.en: Many students in Taiwan become nearsighted at a young age.
ex.zh: 台灣很多學生年紀很小就近視了。

ex.en: I'm nearsighted, so I need glasses to see the board.
ex.zh: 我有近視，所以要戴眼鏡才看得到黑板。

nearsighted.en: able to see things clearly only when they are close

ex.en: She's waiting to pick up her nephew.
ex.zh: 她在等著接她姪子。

ex.en: My nephew is allergic to eggs.
ex.zh: 我姪子對雞蛋過敏。

nephew.en: the son of your brother or sister

ex.en: The newlyweds are spending their honeymoon in Japan.
ex.zh: 這對新婚夫妻正在日本度蜜月。

ex.en: As a newlywed, she is still learning to cook for two.
ex.zh: 身為新婚的人，她還在學習煮兩人份的飯菜。

newlywed.en: a person who has just got married

ex.en: He would be very glad to hear the news.
ex.zh: 他聽到這個消息一定會很高興。

ex.en: Dad! Mom! I have some great news for you!
ex.zh: 爸！媽！我有好消息要告訴你們！

ex.en: When I heard the news, I wanted to cry.
ex.zh: 聽到這個消息時，我想哭。

news.en: new information about something that has happened

ex.en: I watch the news every evening.
ex.zh: 我每天晚上都看新聞。

ex.en: The fire was on the news this morning.
ex.zh: 那場火災上了今天早上的新聞。

news.en: reports about recent events on television, radio, or in papers

ex.en: The school-enterprise networking event was held as scheduled on December 26th.
ex.zh: 校企交流活動已在 12 月 26 日如期舉行。

ex.en: Conferences are great for networking.
ex.zh: 研討會是建立人脈的好機會。

networking.en: the activity of meeting people to make useful contacts

ex.en: Nepotism is quite common in China.
ex.zh: 裙帶關係在中國很普遍。

ex.en: The company was accused of nepotism after hiring the CEO's son.
ex.zh: 公司雇用執行長的兒子後，被指控任人唯親。

nepotism.en: the unfair habit of giving good jobs to your own family

ex.en: Net income rose by eight percent this year.
ex.zh: 今年淨利成長了百分之八。

ex.en: The report compares net income across five years.
ex.zh: 這份報告比較了五年來的淨利。

net income.en: the money left after all costs and taxes have been paid

ex.en: The financial adviser calculated her net worth.
ex.zh: 理財顧問計算了她的資產淨值。

ex.en: The report lists the company's net worth at year-end.
ex.zh: 報告列出公司年底的淨值。

net worth.en: the total value of what a person owns after debts are taken away

ex.en: Tom went to a nearby restaurant to have lunch.
ex.zh: 湯姆去附近的餐館吃午餐。

ex.en: My wife buys vegetables from a supermarket nearby.
ex.zh: 我太太在附近的超市買菜。

ex.en: Excuse me, is there a toilet nearby?
ex.zh: 請問這附近有廁所嗎？

ex.en: Although her house is nearby, I seldom see her.
ex.zh: 雖然她家就在附近，我卻很少見到她。

nearby.en: at a short distance from here or from a place

ex.en: The fire station is next to the police station.
ex.zh: 消防局在警察局的旁邊。

ex.en: The man sitting next to me spoke to me.
ex.zh: 坐在我旁邊的男人跟我說話了。

ex.en: The embassy is located next to the Supreme Court.
ex.zh: 大使館就在最高法院旁邊。

ex.en: Finishing the report by tomorrow is next to impossible.
ex.zh: 在明天前完成報告幾乎是不可能的。

ex.en: It's next to impossible to find a taxi at this hour.
ex.zh: 這個時間幾乎不可能叫到計程車。

next to.en: almost, or very close to being

ex.en: We negotiated a better price with the supplier.
ex.zh: 我們和供應商談到更好的價格。

ex.en: The two sides are still negotiating.
ex.zh: 雙方仍在談判中。

negotiate.en: to talk with others in order to reach an agreement

ex.en: The salary is negotiable.
ex.zh: 薪資可議。

ex.en: Is the price negotiable?
ex.zh: 價格可以再談嗎？

negotiable.en: able to be changed after discussion

ex.en: Our neighbour often waters my plants when I am away.
ex.zh: 我不在的時候，鄰居常常幫我澆花。

ex.en: My new neighbours invited us over for dinner.
ex.zh: 我的新鄰居邀請我們去吃晚餐。

ex.en: She is friendly with every neighbour on her street.
ex.zh: 她和街上每位鄰居都處得很好。

ex.en: Our house neighbours a small park.
ex.zh: 我們家緊鄰一座小公園。

ex.en: The school neighbours a busy train station.
ex.zh: 那所學校緊鄰一個繁忙的火車站。

ex.en: She threaded the needle and started to sew the button.
ex.zh: 她穿好針線，開始縫釦子。

ex.en: The nurse used a thin needle for the injection.
ex.zh: 護理師用很細的針頭打針。

ex.en: The compass needle always points north.
ex.zh: 羅盤的指針總是指向北方。

ex.en: Pine needles covered the forest path.
ex.zh: 松針覆蓋了森林小徑。

ex.en: His brother kept needling him about his haircut.
ex.zh: 他哥哥一直拿他的髮型來挖苦他。

ex.en: Stop needling me, I already said I was sorry.
ex.zh: 別再刺激我了，我已經道歉了。

ex.en: We live in a quiet neighbourhood near the park.
ex.zh: 我們住在公園附近安靜的社區。

ex.en: The whole neighbourhood came to the street festival.
ex.zh: 整個社區的人都來參加街頭慶典。

ex.en: It's a friendly neighbourhood with many small shops.
ex.zh: 這是個友善的社區，有很多小商店。

ex.en: We often visit the neighbouring town on weekends.
ex.zh: 我們週末常去鄰近的城鎮。

ex.en: Neighbouring countries agreed to share the river.
ex.zh: 相鄰的國家同意共用這條河。

ex.en: She folded the clothes neatly.
ex.zh: 她把衣服整齊地摺好。

ex.en: The books were neatly arranged on the shelf.
ex.zh: 書整齊地排放在書架上。

ex.en: He neatly avoided the question.
ex.zh: 他巧妙地避開了那個問題。

ex.en: The two ideas fit neatly together.
ex.zh: 這兩個想法恰好完美地結合在一起。

ex.en: We often drive to the neighboring town for lunch.
ex.zh: 我們常開車到鄰近的小鎮吃午餐。

ex.en: The neighboring countries signed a trade agreement.
ex.zh: 這幾個鄰近國家簽訂了貿易協定。

ex.en: Neil is a name used in many English-speaking countries.
ex.zh: 尼爾是許多英語國家使用的名字。

ex.en: Neil fixed the broken chair with a few nails.
ex.zh: 尼爾用幾根釘子修好了壞掉的椅子。

newcastle.zh: 紐卡素（英國的港口城市）

ex.en: Newcastle is a city in the north of England.
ex.zh: 紐卡素是英格蘭北部的一座城市。

ex.en: They moved to Newcastle because of her new job.
ex.zh: 因為她的新工作，他們搬到了紐卡素。

ex.en: Isaac Newton was an English scientist who studied gravity.
ex.zh: 艾薩克·牛頓是研究重力的英國科學家。

ex.en: Students learn about Newton's laws of motion in physics class.
ex.zh: 學生在物理課上學習牛頓運動定律。

ex.en: One newton is the force needed to move a one-kilogram mass.
ex.zh: 一牛頓是使一公斤物體產生加速度所需的力。

ex.en: The force on the box was measured in newtons.
ex.zh: 作用在箱子上的力是用牛頓來計量的。

ex.en: The Netherlands is a country in western Europe.
ex.zh: 荷蘭是西歐的一個國家。

ex.en: Amsterdam is the capital of the Netherlands.
ex.zh: 阿姆斯特丹是荷蘭的首都。

ex.en: Where is the nearest train station?
ex.zh: 最近的火車站在哪裡？

ex.en: My nearest neighbour lives about a kilometre away.
ex.zh: 我最近的鄰居住在大約一公里外。

ex.en: She waited nervously outside the interview room.
ex.zh: 她緊張地在面試室外等候。

ex.en: He laughed nervously and changed the subject.
ex.zh: 他緊張地笑了笑，然後換了話題。

ex.en: The boy nervously held his mother's hand on the first day of school.
ex.zh: 開學第一天，男孩緊張地握著媽媽的手。

ex.en: The heavy snow may necessitate closing the school.
ex.zh: 大雪可能使學校不得不停課。

ex.en: Her new job will necessitate moving to another city.
ex.zh: 她的新工作會使她必須搬到另一個城市。

ex.en: Stress can affect your health negatively.
ex.zh: 壓力可能對你的健康造成負面影響。

ex.en: He reacted negatively to the new plan.
ex.zh: 他對新計畫的反應很消極。

ex.en: It was a needless risk to drive in the storm.
ex.zh: 在暴風雨中開車是不必要的冒險。

ex.en: Let's avoid needless expenses this month.
ex.zh: 這個月我們避免不必要的開銷吧。

ex.en: Needless to say, she passed the exam easily.
ex.zh: 不用說，她輕鬆通過了考試。

ex.en: Needless to say, we were all very tired.
ex.zh: 不用說，我們都累壞了。

ex.en: The station is nearer than I thought.
ex.zh: 車站比我想的還近。

ex.en: Is there a nearer store on this street?
ex.zh: 這條街上有比較近的商店嗎？

ex.en: The nurse carried the newborn to its mother.
ex.zh: 護士把新生兒抱給媽媽。

ex.en: A newborn sleeps most of the day.
ex.zh: 新生兒一天大部分時間都在睡覺。

ex.en: The newborn baby weighed three kilos.
ex.zh: 那個剛出生的寶寶重三公斤。

ex.en: We saw a newborn calf standing next to its mother.
ex.zh: 我們看到一隻剛出生的小牛站在牠媽媽旁邊。

ex.en: Neon signs lit up the street at night.
ex.zh: 夜裡霓虹燈招牌照亮了街道。

ex.en: The shop window glowed with pink neon.
ex.zh: 店面的櫥窗閃著粉紅色的霓虹光。

ex.en: Neon is a colorless gas used in many lights.
ex.zh: 氖是一種無色氣體，用在許多燈具中。

ex.en: Neon makes a bright orange-red glow when electricity passes through it.
ex.zh: 電流通過氖氣時會發出明亮的橘紅色光。

ex.en: Through the telescope, we saw a glowing nebula in the night sky.
ex.zh: 透過望遠鏡，我們看見夜空中一團發光的星雲。

ex.en: A nebula is a huge cloud of gas and dust in space.
ex.zh: 星雲是太空中巨大的氣體與塵埃雲。

ex.en: The cost of the repair was negligible.
ex.zh: 修理的費用微不足道。

ex.en: The difference in price is negligible.
ex.zh: 價格上的差異可以忽略不計。

ex.en: The storm caused only negligible damage to the farm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨只對農場造成輕微的損害。

ex.en: The cat likes to nestle into the blanket on the sofa.
ex.zh: 那隻貓喜歡窩進沙發上的毯子裡。

ex.en: The child nestled against her mother's shoulder and fell asleep.
ex.zh: 那孩子依偎在媽媽的肩膀上睡著了。

ex.en: The little village nestles in a valley between two hills.
ex.zh: 那個小村莊坐落在兩座山丘之間的山谷裡。

ex.en: A small cabin nestled among the pine trees.
ex.zh: 一間小木屋依偎在松樹林之間。

ex.en: Negotiating a good salary takes practice.
ex.zh: 談出好薪水需要練習。

ex.en: She is skilled at negotiating with difficult clients.
ex.zh: 她很擅長與難搞的客戶協商。

ex.en: The country has kept its neutrality in the conflict.
ex.zh: 這個國家在衝突中一直保持中立。

ex.en: A judge must show neutrality in every case.
ex.zh: 法官在每個案件中都必須秉持中立。

ex.en: A neutron has no electric charge.
ex.zh: 中子不帶電荷。

ex.en: Every atom except the simplest hydrogen has at least one neutron.
ex.zh: 除了最簡單的氫以外，每個原子至少都有一個中子。

ex.en: She enjoyed her newfound freedom after college.
ex.zh: 大學畢業後，她享受著新得到的自由。

ex.en: He used his newfound confidence to speak up in class.
ex.zh: 他憑著新建立的自信在課堂上發言。

ex.en: The neglected garden was full of weeds.
ex.zh: 那座沒人照顧的花園長滿了雜草。

ex.en: He felt neglected when his friends forgot his birthday.
ex.zh: 朋友忘了他的生日，讓他覺得被冷落了。

ex.en: The old library is a neglected part of the town.
ex.zh: 舊圖書館是小鎮上被忽視的一角。

ex.en: The driver was negligent and did not check his mirrors.
ex.zh: 那位駕駛很疏忽，沒有查看後照鏡。

ex.en: The court said the hospital was negligent in caring for the patient.
ex.zh: 法院認為醫院在照顧病人方面有疏失。

newport.zh: （紐波特，美國羅德島州的海濱城市）

ex.en: Newport is a seaside city in Rhode Island.
ex.zh: 紐波特是羅德島州的一座海濱城市。

ex.en: Many tourists visit Newport for its sailing and old mansions.
ex.zh: 許多觀光客造訪紐波特，為的是它的帆船和古老大宅。

ex.en: Baking soda can neutralize acid in the stomach.
ex.zh: 小蘇打可以中和胃裡的酸。

ex.en: The defender managed to neutralize the star player.
ex.zh: 那位後衛成功封鎖了明星球員。

ex.en: Good planning can neutralize most risks.
ex.zh: 良好的規劃可以化解大部分風險。

ex.en: The patient was sent to a neurological clinic for tests.
ex.zh: 病人被送到神經科診所做檢查。

ex.en: Brain injuries can cause long-term neurological problems.
ex.zh: 腦部受傷可能造成長期的神經系統問題。

ex.en: Nepal is home to Mount Everest.
ex.zh: 尼泊爾擁有聖母峰。

ex.en: Nepal lies between China and India.
ex.zh: 尼泊爾位於中國與印度之間。

ex.en: She tried to hide her nervousness before the interview.
ex.zh: 面試前她試著掩飾自己的緊張。

ex.en: His nervousness made his hands shake.
ex.zh: 他的緊張讓雙手發抖。

ex.en: The newsroom was noisy as reporters rushed to finish their stories.
ex.zh: 記者們趕著完成稿子，新聞編輯室裡吵雜不已。

ex.en: He worked in a busy newsroom for ten years before becoming a teacher.
ex.zh: 他在忙碌的新聞編輯室工作十年後才轉行當老師。

ex.en: I bought a magazine at the newsagent near the station.
ex.zh: 我在車站附近的報攤買了一本雜誌。

ex.en: The local newsagent delivers papers to our street every morning.
ex.zh: 當地的報刊經銷商每天早上把報紙送到我們這條街。

ex.en: A neutrino can pass through the Earth almost without stopping.
ex.zh: 微中子幾乎能不受阻礙地穿過整個地球。

ex.en: Scientists built a huge detector to catch a neutrino.
ex.zh: 科學家建造了一座巨大的偵測器來捕捉微中子。

ex.en: I touched a nettle and my hand started to itch.
ex.zh: 我碰到蕁麻，手開始發癢。

ex.en: Nettle tea is popular in some countries.
ex.zh: 蕁麻茶在一些國家很受歡迎。

ex.en: His rude remark really nettled her.
ex.zh: 他無禮的話真的惹惱了她。

ex.en: The constant noise nettled the whole class.
ex.zh: 不停的噪音讓全班都很煩。

ex.en: He is neurotic about keeping his desk perfectly clean.
ex.zh: 他對保持桌面一塵不染很神經質。

ex.en: Her neurotic worrying made the trip stressful.
ex.zh: 她神經質的擔心讓這趟旅行壓力很大。

ex.en: My uncle calls himself a neurotic who checks the door three times.
ex.zh: 我叔叔說自己是個會檢查門三次的神經質的人。

ex.en: Don't be such a neurotic; the plane will be fine.
ex.zh: 別這麼神經質，飛機沒問題的。

negotiated.zh: 談判；協商（negotiate 的過去式）

ex.en: The two companies negotiated a new contract.
ex.zh: 兩家公司協商出一份新合約。

ex.en: The union negotiated a better schedule for its workers.
ex.zh: 工會為員工談成了更好的工作時程。

ex.en: The driver carefully negotiated the narrow mountain road.
ex.zh: 司機小心地駛過狹窄的山路。

ex.en: The hikers negotiated a steep slope in the rain.
ex.zh: 健行者在雨中越過了陡坡。

ex.en: We hung mosquito netting over the bed.
ex.zh: 我們在床上掛了蚊帳。

ex.en: Wire netting keeps the chickens inside the yard.
ex.zh: 鐵絲網把雞圍在院子裡。

ex.en: One careless mistake can negate hours of hard work.
ex.zh: 一個粗心的錯誤就可能讓好幾個小時的努力白費。

ex.en: The new evidence negates his earlier claim.
ex.zh: 新的證據推翻了他先前的說法。

ex.en: Eating junk food can negate the benefits of exercise.
ex.zh: 吃垃圾食物可能抵消運動的好處。

ex.en: Ned is a short form of the name Edward.
ex.zh: 奈德是愛德華這個名字的簡稱。

ex.en: Ned waved to us from across the street.
ex.zh: 奈德從對街對我們揮手。

newark.zh: 紐華克（美國紐澤西州的城市）

ex.en: Newark is the largest city in the state of New Jersey.
ex.zh: 紐華克是紐澤西州最大的城市。

ex.en: Many flights land at the airport in Newark every day.
ex.zh: 每天有許多班機降落在紐華克的機場。

newscast.zh: 新聞廣播；電視新聞節目

ex.en: My father watches the evening newscast every day.
ex.zh: 我爸爸每天都看晚間新聞。

ex.en: The newscast opened with a report on the storm.
ex.zh: 新聞節目一開始就報導了那場暴風雨。

ex.en: The neurologist ordered a scan to check her headaches.
ex.zh: 神經科醫師安排了掃描來檢查她的頭痛。

ex.en: My uncle works as a neurologist at a large hospital.
ex.zh: 我叔叔在一家大醫院擔任神經科醫師。

ex.en: The city is the nexus of trade in the region.
ex.zh: 這座城市是該地區貿易的樞紐。

ex.en: There is a close nexus between sleep and health.
ex.zh: 睡眠與健康之間有密切的關聯。

ex.en: He was a computer nerd who loved building robots.
ex.zh: 他是個愛組裝機器人的電腦宅。

ex.en: Call me a nerd, but I love reading science books.
ex.zh: 隨便你說我是書呆子，但我就是愛讀科學書。

ex.en: Birds are nesting in the old barn.
ex.zh: 鳥兒在舊穀倉裡築巢。

ex.en: The swans are nesting by the lake.
ex.zh: 天鵝在湖邊築巢。

ex.en: The guards moved quickly to neutralise the threat.
ex.zh: 警衛迅速行動以化解威脅。

ex.en: Antacids neutralise the acid in your stomach.
ex.zh: 制酸劑能中和胃裡的酸。

ex.en: Bees collect nectar from flowers to make honey.
ex.zh: 蜜蜂從花朵採集花蜜來釀蜜。

ex.en: The hummingbird drank the sweet nectar with its long beak.
ex.zh: 蜂鳥用長長的喙喝著甜甜的花蜜。

ex.en: The juice tasted like nectar on a hot day.
ex.zh: 大熱天裡，這杯果汁喝起來有如甘露。

ex.en: She served peach nectar at the party.
ex.zh: 她在派對上端出了水蜜桃果汁。

ex.en: The museum is a neoclassical building with tall columns.
ex.zh: 這間博物館是有著高聳圓柱的新古典主義建築。

ex.en: She loves neoclassical music from the early twentieth century.
ex.zh: 她喜歡二十世紀初的新古典主義音樂。

ex.en: The younger player has always been his nemesis on the court.
ex.zh: 那位年輕選手一直是他在球場上的剋星。

ex.en: Math was her nemesis all through high school.
ex.zh: 整個高中時期，數學都是她的剋星。

ex.en: The doctor said her anxiety was a form of neurosis.
ex.zh: 醫生說她的焦慮是神經症的一種。

ex.en: Freud wrote a great deal about neurosis.
ex.zh: 佛洛伊德曾對神經症寫了大量著作。

ex.en: Neptune is the farthest planet from the Sun in our solar system.
ex.zh: 海王星是太陽系中離太陽最遠的行星。

ex.en: Neptune takes about 165 years to orbit the Sun.
ex.zh: 海王星繞太陽一圈大約需要 165 年。

newfoundland.zh: 紐芬蘭（加拿大東部島嶼與省分）

ex.en: Newfoundland is an island on the east coast of Canada.
ex.zh: 紐芬蘭是加拿大東岸的一座島嶼。

ex.en: We watched whales from the shore in Newfoundland.
ex.zh: 我們在紐芬蘭的海岸邊看鯨魚。

ex.en: Adding "not" to a sentence is a simple form of negation.
ex.zh: 在句子裡加上 not 是一種簡單的否定方式。

ex.en: Silence is not always a negation of what was said.
ex.zh: 沉默並不一定是對所說之事的否定。

ex.en: My fingers were black from the cheap newsprint.
ex.zh: 便宜的新聞紙把我的手指弄黑了。

ex.en: We wrapped the glasses in sheets of newsprint.
ex.zh: 我們用新聞紙把玻璃杯包起來。

ex.en: Archaeologists found Neolithic tools near the river.
ex.zh: 考古學家在河邊發現了新石器時代的工具。

ex.en: The Neolithic period began when people started farming.
ex.zh: 新石器時代始於人類開始務農之時。

ex.en: He wore a blue necktie to the job interview.
ex.zh: 他戴著藍色領帶去面試。

ex.en: My father taught me how to tie a necktie.
ex.zh: 我爸爸教我怎麼打領帶。

ex.en: All the computers in the office are networked.
ex.zh: 辦公室裡所有電腦都連上了網路。

ex.en: A networked printer lets everyone share one machine.
ex.zh: 連網的印表機讓大家共用一台機器。

ex.en: You are worrying needlessly about the exam.
ex.zh: 你為這場考試擔心得毫無必要。

ex.en: The meeting was needlessly long.
ex.zh: 這場會議長得沒有必要。
